name: nalanda-erp-mobile
description: Native mobile wrapper (iOS + Android) for Nalanda Enterprises ERP. Adds true background GPS, push notifications, biometric login.

scripts.build:android: yarn build:web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios: yarn build:web && cap sync ios && echo 'Open Xcode and Archive: yarn open:ios'
scripts.run:android: yarn build:web && cap sync android && cap run android
